description: This file defines a functional interface called HttpPushContext that encapsulates the logic for handling HTTP responses received when publishing an ExternalMessage to an endpoint. It contains a single method onResponse() which processes the asynchronous HttpResponse.

classes.name: HttpPushContext
classes.description: A functional interface representing the context for HTTP push operations, specifically to handle responses from an HTTP endpoint.

methods.name: onResponse
methods.description: Handles the HTTP response received after attempting to publish an ExternalMessage. It takes a Try<HttpResponse> to accommodate successful responses or failures.
